_comment: CSRD scope as amended by the Omnibus package. These thresholds and dates are
the single most consequential thing this tool asserts, so they carry their
sources and a confidence grade like every factor in the register does.
Primary sources (EUR-Lex, EFRAG) could not be reached from the build
environment, so these are taken from professional-firm summaries and graded
medium rather than high. Verify against the directive before relying on them

sources.title: CSRD post-Omnibus revised scope and requirements

eu_company.note: Both conditions must be met. The Omnibus raised the employee threshold substantially and added a turnover test, taking a large number of previously in-scope companies out.

non_eu_group.note: Non-EU parent groups generating more than this in the EU.

waves.note: Companies already in scope continue reporting — FY2025 published in 2026, FY2026 published in 2027.
Deferred by the Omnibus from its original timetable.

simplified_esrs.note: The simplified ESRS set had not been published when this tool was built. It is expected to reduce the number of disclosures substantially and lean harder on materiality. Any datapoint-level gap analysis built against ESRS Set 1 (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/2772) is therefore provisional — which is why this tool works at standard level and says so rather than enumerating datapoints that are about to change.
